summary: Determine the age of the uncommitted local changes from filesystem timestamps and session records.

intervals.description: Inspected modified-file last-write times and the November 5 activity-session records.
evidence: User asks how old the uncommitted work is.

results: Tracked-file last-write timestamps range from 2026-11-03 14:42 to 2026-11-05 17:19 local time.
The latest logged rendering-focused session ended 2026-11-05 17:23 local time; it documents the timebase hold, signal centering, EEG decimation, and low-latency SC/PPG filter review.
limitations: Filesystem last-write timestamps show the latest recorded edit time, not when the work originally began; copied files or later edits can change them.
